svg.title: Model lineage: from raw tables to results
svg.desc: Lineage diagram of the dbt project: six raw source tables feed six staging views, which feed five intermediate views and seven mart tables, ending in fct_fix_ranking.
svg.text: Model lineage: from raw tables to results
Every dbt model and the models it reads. Data flows top to bottom: 6 raw tables, 6 staging views, 5 intermediate views and 7 mart tables.
arrow = is read by (from the ref() and source() calls)
